subject.title: feat: keep reset session history searchable

question: Should manual `/reset` and `/new` now retain prior SQLite generations until explicit deletion or physical disk pressure, despite the related merged reset-policy work describing manual reset behavior as unchanged?
rationale: This is an intentional user-visible retention and deletion-policy change with upgrade implications; tests cannot determine whether replacing the prior manual-reset contract is the desired product direction.

options.title: Sponsor durable reset history
options.body: Approve the new retention contract, require runtime proof for search and pressure eviction, and document the upgrade behavior clearly.

options.title: Preserve existing manual reset semantics
options.body: Keep reset archival/removal behavior and limit durable retention to a separately designed, explicitly approved product path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor durable reset history
recommendation.body: Approve the new retention contract, require runtime proof for search and pressure eviction, and document the upgrade behavior clearly.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent merged reset-policy change and this directly related retention proposal.
